sourceEvidence.title: Supplier Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
### Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required.
- 5+ years in aerospace supplier quality or manufacturing quality.
- 3+ years direct leadership experience.
- Strong knowledge of APQP/PPAP (AS9145) and related tools.
- Solid understanding of QMS and AS9100/AS9145 standards.
